title: Panel groups, dock and tab strip
summary: PanelGroup (tabbed panel with chip tabs, minimise, drag a tab between groups), Dock (two columns of panels: reorder by header drag, hide, float in a window, dock back, remembered arrangement) and Tabs (document tab strip with pin, progress line and window title).
description: Create a group with `new PanelGroup(host, id, tabs, label)`; the header carries `cv-panel-head` so the Dock moves it. `Dock` takes the two column hosts and keeps `{order, hidden, side}` plus heights and floats in localStorage (`formvis.dock*`; `Dock.remember` can turn writes off). Panels are registered with `registerPanel`. `Tabs` is the document strip and is bound to the formvis engine (`tabName`, `Engine`, `Project`), so a port adapts it; it sets the window title through the Tauri `set_window_title` command. Group state lives under `formvis.groups`. Central to the formcut and formwav panel layouts.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
User-visible strings go through t() from the i18n module; the English text is the key.
Icons are inline currentColor SVG strings from the icons module (icon(name, size)); no icon library, and the three-star sparkle icon is banned under any name.
Stacking above local ordering uses var(--z-*) from the one z scale; a raw numeric z-index is not allowed.
A movable panel header carries cv-panel-head so Dock can move it; do not give panels another drag handle.
